title: An on-chip AXI traffic generator and protocol checker
tagline: A block beside the IP under test that drives AXI4-Lite and AXI4-Stream traffic from a program loaded at run time and checks every protocol rule in hardware

facts.text: All 6 seeded protocol bugs were caught on the Nexys A7 by the rule each breaks; AMD's AXI Protocol Checker on the same bus agreed in 17 of 17 runs.
The board's traffic matched the cocotb simulation cycle for cycle in 13 of 13 runs, with 0 differences in 936 logged transactions.
The checker is proved: 30 of 30 bounded proofs and 34 of 34 deliberately broken checkers caught.

media.alt: A waveform captured on the board, replayed cycle by cycle: after the address handshake the peripheral raises BVALID before any write data, the checker's B_EARLY rule goes high and the write data arrives only afterwards.
media.note: Recorded from the showcase page's own hero (results/59a_axi_tx/hero.json) by axi_tx/portfolio_capture.js.

status: Measured on the board; full AXI4, the slave side and soak testing are the next phase.
